meta.title: The MUI X Data Grid alternative for any framework | AG Grid
meta.description: Looking for a MUI X Data Grid alternative? AG Grid is a JavaScript data grid for React, Angular, Vue and JavaScript with a free MIT-licensed core. Compare features, pricing and licensing.

hero.heading: A MUI X Data Grid alternative
hero.subHeading: AG Grid is a JavaScript data grid for React, Angular, Vue and plain JavaScript, with unlimited row virtualisation in its free MIT-licensed Community edition.

whySwitch.heading: Why teams look for a MUI X Data Grid alternative
reasons: MUI X Data Grid is built for React only and depends on Material UI.
Row virtualisation in the free MUI X Data Grid is limited to 100 rows.
Column pinning and lazy loading need the Pro plan; row grouping, pivoting and Excel export need Premium.

whyProduct.title: One grid for every framework
whyProduct.body: Official packages for React, Angular and Vue, plus plain JavaScript, with the same grid features in each.

whyProduct.title: Large datasets in the free version
whyProduct.body: Row and column virtualisation are on by default in AG Grid Community, and the Infinite Row Model loads data from the server as users scroll.

whyProduct.title: Analysis built into the grid
whyProduct.body: AG Grid Enterprise adds row grouping, aggregation, pivoting, master/detail, Excel export and integrated charts to the same component.

whyProduct.title: Clear licensing
whyProduct.body: AG Grid Community is MIT licensed. AG Grid Enterprise is a perpetual licence with one year of updates and support.

faq.question: What is a free alternative to MUI X Data Grid Pro?
faq.answer: AG Grid Community is free under the MIT licence and includes unlimited row virtualisation, column pinning and lazy loading from the server, which MUI X puts in its paid Pro plan.

faq.question: Is MUI Data Grid Pro free?
faq.answer: No. MUI X Pro is a paid plan, sold per developer as an annual licence or as a perpetual licence with 12 months of updates and support.

faq.question: Does AG Grid work with Material UI?
faq.answer: AG Grid is not built on Material UI. It has its own Theming API and Theme Builder for styling the grid to match an application's design.

faq.question: How much does an AG Grid licence cost?
faq.answer: AG Grid Community is free. AG Grid Enterprise, and the Enterprise Bundle with AG Charts Enterprise, are paid perpetual licences that include one year of updates and support. See [AG Grid pricing](/license-pricing/) for prices.

proseClaims.claim: MUI X Data Grid is built exclusively for React.
MUI X Data Grid has a peer dependency on Material UI (@mui/material).
In the free MUI X Data Grid, row virtualisation is limited to 100 rows; row virtualisation is a Pro plan feature.
MUI X Data Grid column pinning needs the Pro plan.
MUI X Data Grid server-side lazy loading needs the Pro plan.
MUI X Data Grid row grouping and Excel export need the Premium plan.
MUI X Data Grid pivoting needs the Premium plan.
MUI X Pro and Premium are sold per developer as an annual licence or a perpetual licence with 12 months of updates and support.
